critical_code_review_comments: _validate_world_level_config (world_routes.py ~L2503) hard-codes token_unlock_enabled=False when admin saves levels_config, contradicting the new default in _default_world_level_config. Currently harmless because the seeded active contest keeps the default merge path, but any admin edit of levels_config will silently disable token early-unlock again. Recommend deriving token_unlock_enabled from the incoming item (default True) inside _validate_world_level_config.
activate_admin_world_contest contains dead code 'if int(1 or 1) != 1' (world_routes.py L1277) which is always false — likely leftover from a validation refactor; safe to remove.

acquisition_routes._classify_source treats any subdomain containing 'google' as organic_search via substring match, which could false-positive on hosts like 'notgoogle.com'; consider matching on registrable domain.
